nodes.label: Sections
nodes.description: Defines all sections, their ordering, impact levels, and descriptions for React performance optimization rules.

nodes.description: Template for creating rule files with frontmatter metadata including title, impact level, and tags.

nodes.label: Do Not Put Effect Events in Dependency Arrays
nodes.description: Effect Event functions do not have stable identity and should not be included in useEffect dependency arrays.
nodes.norm_label: do not put effect events in dependency arrays

nodes.label: Store Event Handlers in Refs
nodes.description: Store callbacks in refs when used in effects that should not re-subscribe on callback changes.

nodes.label: Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
nodes.description: Do not put app-wide initialization inside useEffect of a component; use module-level guard instead.
nodes.norm_label: initialize app once, not per mount

nodes.label: useEffectEvent for Stable Callback Refs
nodes.description: Access latest values in callbacks without adding them to dependency arrays using useEffectEvent.

nodes.label: Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes
nodes.description: Start independent operations immediately in API routes and Server Actions, even before awaiting them.
nodes.norm_label: prevent waterfall chains in api routes

nodes.label: Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.description: Evaluate cheap synchronous conditions first before making async calls to avoid unnecessary network requests.
nodes.norm_label: check cheap conditions before async flags

nodes.label: Defer Await Until Needed
nodes.description: Move await operations into the branches where they are actually used to avoid blocking unused code paths.

nodes.label: Dependency-Based Parallelization
nodes.description: Use better-all library to maximize parallelism for operations with partial dependencies.

nodes.label: Promise.all() for Independent Operations
nodes.description: Execute independent async operations concurrently using Promise.all() to reduce round trips.

nodes.label: Strategic Suspense Boundaries
nodes.description: Use Suspense boundaries to show wrapper UI faster while data loads instead of blocking entire page.

nodes.label: Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths
nodes.description: Keep import and file-system paths obvious at build time to avoid broad bundles and file traces.

nodes.label: Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.description: Import directly from source files instead of barrel files to avoid loading thousands of unused modules.

nodes.label: Conditional Module Loading
nodes.description: Load large data or modules only when a feature is activated using dynamic imports.

nodes.label: Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries
nodes.description: Load analytics, logging, and error tracking after hydration using next/dynamic with ssr: false.

nodes.label: Dynamic Imports for Heavy Components
nodes.description: Use next/dynamic to lazy-load large components not needed on initial render to improve TTI and LCP.

nodes.label: Preload Based on User Intent
nodes.description: Preload heavy bundles before they are needed to reduce perceived latency.

nodes.label: Deduplicate Global Event Listeners
nodes.description: Use useSWRSubscription to share global event listeners across component instances.

nodes.label: Version and Minimize localStorage Data
nodes.description: Add version prefix to localStorage keys and store only needed fields to prevent schema conflicts.

nodes.label: Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
nodes.description: Add { passive: true } to touch and wheel event listeners to enable immediate scrolling.
nodes.norm_label: use passive event listeners for scrolling performance

nodes.label: Use SWR for Automatic Deduplication
nodes.description: SWR enables request deduplication, caching, and revalidation across component instances.

nodes.label: Authorization-Preserving Parallelization
nodes.description: Investigation guardrail ensuring parallelizing awaits does not move private data access ahead of auth/ownership/tenant/permission checks. Must preserve sequential guard or replace with authorized query.

nodes.description: Investigation guardrail for Bot Protection recommendations. Must be grounded in observed automated traffic or meaningful edge-request scale. Never recommend disabling security products to reduce cost.

nodes.label: Build Minutes Monorepo Fanout
nodes.description: Investigation guardrail for build minutes climbing when commits rebuild unchanged work. Common causes: TURBO_FORCE, cache false, missing outputs, or disabled build-skip settings.

nodes.label: Cache Components Static Shell Boundaries
nodes.description: Investigation guardrail for Next.js 16 Cache Components. Avoids older segment-config advice; focuses on keeping static shell while dynamic data moves behind explicit cached or runtime boundaries.

nodes.label: Cache Components Suspense Dedupe Pitfall
nodes.description: Investigation guardrail for Next.js 16 Cache Components. Default 'use cache' does not dedupe identical calls across separate Suspense boundaries on the same render, multiplying function-duration and ISR write churn.

nodes.label: CDN Cache Auth Safety
nodes.description: Investigation guardrail treating edge caching as a safety question first. Route must be a public, cacheable GET path before shared-cache recommendation is allowed. Must rule out cookies, sessions, auth, draft state.

nodes.label: Cold-Start Initialization and Bundle Weight

nodes.label: Database Region and Connection Pressure

nodes.label: Dynamic Rendering Traps

nodes.label: Cross-Framework External API Critical Path

nodes.label: External API Critical Path

nodes.label: Fast Data Transfer Payloads

nodes.label: Middleware Edge Cost
nodes.description: Middleware runs on the edge and its cost scales with the number of requests it intercepts. Narrowing the matcher config reduces unnecessary edge execution.

nodes.label: Middleware Matcher Config
nodes.description: The matcher config in middleware determines which paths trigger middleware execution. Overly broad matchers increase edge cost.

nodes.label: Fetch Revalidation Floor
nodes.description: Next.js fetch options can set the route's effective cache floor. Low revalidate, revalidate: 0, or cache: 'no-store' explains uncached traffic and excessive ISR work.

nodes.label: Font CLS Guardrail
nodes.description: For poor CLS, check fonts only when the route loads external font CSS or swaps text after render. Use next/font to self-host fonts and prevent CLS.

nodes.label: Heavy UI Lazy-Load Boundaries
nodes.description: Heavy above-the-fold or rarely used UI hurts LCP and INP when too much JavaScript ships on first load. Use next/dynamic to split heavy components.

nodes.label: Image LCP Preload and Sizes
nodes.description: Hero images need correct sizing, priority behavior, and source-cache hygiene. Inspect next/image for fill without sizes, deprecated priority, and missing preload.

nodes.label: Route Handler GET Cache Defaults
nodes.description: On Next.js 15+, GET Route Handlers are dynamic by default. Verify whether uncached behavior is intentional before recommending cache headers.

nodes.label: Third-Party Script Strategy
nodes.description: Third-party scripts are only actionable when they line up with poor metrics. Use next/script with beforeInteractive, afterInteractive, or lazyOnload strategies.

nodes.label: Next.js Cache Semantics by Version
nodes.description: On Next.js 15+, match fixes to the cache primitive already in use: 'use cache', cacheLife, cacheTag, fetch cache options, route handlers, and dynamic APIs.

nodes.label: Not-Found and Catch-All Request Waste
nodes.description: High-volume 404 or catch-all traffic is often request waste from legacy URLs, bots, broken links, or a real product route. Use redirects, rewrites, or WAF rules.

nodes.label: Nuxt routeRules Cache and ISR
nodes.description: For Nuxt on Vercel, route-level caching belongs in routeRules. Match lever to route: prerender for static, ISR for shared content, SSR for request-specific.

nodes.label: Observability Events Cost Attribution
nodes.description: Observability Events is the metered SKU under Observability Plus. Reduce upstream by lifting cache hit rate, narrowing middleware matchers, and reducing custom-span cardinality.

nodes.label: Post-Response Work with waitUntil
nodes.description: For stacks without Next.js after(), non-critical work (analytics, logging, notifications) can run after the response via waitUntil instead of extending latency.

nodes.label: Durable Offload for Timeout-Heavy Routes
nodes.description: Timeout-heavy routes often need a job boundary, not a higher limit. Workflow fits durable multi-step work that continues after the response.

nodes.label: Route Errors and Runtime Limits
nodes.description: Route error candidates are reliability findings with cost impact. Determine whether failures are app exceptions, timeouts, payload limits, or deployment regressions.

nodes.label: Runtime Cache for Reusable Server Data
nodes.description: Runtime Cache is useful when the same server-side result is reused across requests. Treat it as a measured alternative when CDN response caching is unsafe.
nodes.norm_label: runtime cache for reusable server data

nodes.label: SvelteKit ISR and Prerender Safety
nodes.description: For SvelteKit, the right lever is often prerender or adapter ISR on public pages. Prove every visitor can safely see the same response for the interval.

nodes.label: SvelteKit Split Function Cold-Start Tradeoff
nodes.description: SvelteKit bundles routes together to avoid excessive cold starts. Treat split: true as a targeted tradeoff, not a blanket optimization.

nodes.label: Usage Spike Triage
nodes.description: A single-day or single-SKU spike needs cause before fix. Branches: bot/AI crawler on cacheable route, viral moment, pricing migration, or code regression.

nodes.label: 'use cache' Date-Stamp ISR Write Amplifier
nodes.description: 'use cache' keys on argument identity. A new Date(), Date.now(), or Math.random() in cached output forces a fresh ISR write on every regeneration.

nodes.label: Remote Cache for Shared Origin Data
nodes.description: For Next 16, shared origin data or reusable route-handler work belongs in remote cache. Use 'use cache: remote' or generateStaticParams.
nodes.norm_label: remote cache for shared origin data

nodes.label: Workflow Resumable Stream Routes
nodes.description: Stream-shaped routes may be Workflow SDK reconnection endpoints. Long wall-clock duration can be the live client connection, not a bug.

nodes.label: contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior for Safe Areas
nodes.description: Use contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior='automatic' on root ScrollView instead of SafeAreaView or manual padding. Lets iOS handle safe area insets natively.

nodes.label: ISR Revalidation
nodes.description: Incremental Static Regeneration revalidation controls how often cached pages are refreshed. Low revalidate values increase ISR work.

nodes.label: 'use cache' Directive
nodes.description: The 'use cache' directive in Next.js 15+ enables function-level caching with cacheLife and cacheTag controls.

nodes.label: Workflow SDK
nodes.description: Vercel Workflow SDK enables durable multi-step work that continues after the response, with resumable streams and job boundaries.

nodes.label: WAF Rules for Request Waste
nodes.description: Vercel Firewall WAF rules can log or block 404 and catch-all traffic patterns to reduce wasted function invocations.

nodes.label: SafeAreaView Wrapper Anti-Pattern
nodes.description: Wrapping ScrollView in SafeAreaView is an incorrect pattern. Use contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior='automatic' instead for native safe area handling.

nodes.description: Project README for Sema TEI Corpus Explorer. Documents features, prerequisites, quick start, all commands, project structure, admin usage, XML parser limitations, and syncing changes.

nodes.label: Provider Failover
nodes.description: AI Gateway active-active fallback chain across providers (OpenAI + Anthropic). Critical-path agents must not be single-provider to avoid user-visible outages on 429.

nodes.label: OIDC Keyless Auth
nodes.description: Using AI Gateway OIDC binding so requests are signed by deployment identity instead of explicit API keys. In local dev, vercel env run rotates OIDC each run.

nodes.label: Sandbox Reuse
nodes.description: Pooling sandboxes by name (sandbox.get) instead of per-request Sandbox.create. Each fresh sandbox costs at least 1 minute of billed compute. Auto-snapshot on death and auto-resume.

nodes.label: Fluid Compute
nodes.description: Vercel feature for JIT/process warmth. Streaming LLM responses benefit from warm processes. Default setting; disabling on AI workloads is almost always wrong.

nodes.label: Cache-Control at Edge
nodes.description: Shipping Cache-Control headers on idempotent GET endpoints so the CDN serves repeat callers without invoking the function. Most common finding in API service profile.

nodes.label: Edge Rate Limiting
nodes.description: Using middleware with proper matcher scoping to handle abusive clients before they hit function-duration bill. Applied at edge, not in the function.

nodes.label: Parallel External API Calls
nodes.description: Using Promise.all for independent external API calls instead of sequential awaits. Common slow_route pattern in checkout-like endpoints calling Stripe + inventory + email.

nodes.label: Connection Pooling
nodes.description: Using PgBouncer / Prisma Accelerate / Neon pooler for database connections. Direct PG connections from serverless function instances exhaust the database.

nodes.label: ISR Optimization
nodes.description: Incremental Static Regeneration with sensible cadence. Pages needing fresh-ish content but not real-time accuracy go ISR. Good starting point: revalidate 3600 for docs, 60 for blog index.

nodes.label: Pre-rendering
nodes.description: Pre-rendering everything that can be pre-rendered using generateStaticParams (App Router) or getStaticPaths (Pages Router). CMS-driven content on webhook revalidation, not on every request.

nodes.label: next/image Optimization
nodes.description: Using next/image for every image asset. Even thumbnail-only sites benefit from format negotiation (WebP/AVIF). Mandatory for product images to avoid dominating the bill.

nodes.label: Bot Protection
nodes.description: Vercel Bot Protection for marketing campaigns that attract competitor scrapers and bot traffic inflating edge requests. Often pays for itself within a month.

nodes.label: React.cache() Deduplication
nodes.description: Per-request memoization with React.cache() for Server Components called from multiple places in the same request tree that re-query the database.

nodes.label: Suspense Boundaries
nodes.description: Placing Suspense boundaries around expensive widgets so dashboard shell renders fast and widgets stream in, shifting perceived latency without changing underlying queries.

nodes.label: after()/waitUntil() Post-Response
nodes.description: Using after() (Next 15+) or waitUntil() from @vercel/functions for non-blocking background work after user response. Used for analytics, audit writes, webhooks-to-self.

nodes.label: React ViewTransition Component
nodes.description: React component that wraps content for view transition animations. React auto-assigns view-transition-name and calls document.startViewTransition. Supports enter, exit, update, and share triggers.

nodes.label: Suspense Reveals
nodes.description: Wrapping Suspense fallback and content in separate ViewTransitions for skeleton-to-content animation. Uses simple string props since Suspense resolves fire without transition types.

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Accessibility
nodes.description: CSS media query (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) that sets animation-duration and animation-delay to 0s for all view transition pseudo-elements. Required for accessibility compliance.

nodes.label: Transition Types
nodes.description: Tagging transitions with addTransitionType so ViewTransitions can pick different animations. Works on enter, exit, and share. Types are available during navigation but not during subsequent Suspense reveals.

nodes.label: default="none" Pattern
nodes.description: Always use default="none" on ViewTransition components to prevent browser default cross-fade on every transition. Explicitly enable only desired triggers.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Pattern
nodes.description: Directional slides + Suspense reveals coexist because they fire at different moments. Directional VT in page component (not layout), Suspense VT around content with default="none".

nodes.label: loading.tsx as Suspense Boundary
nodes.description: Next.js loading.tsx files are implicit Suspense boundaries. Wrap skeleton in ViewTransition exit in loading.tsx, content in ViewTransition enter with default="none" in page.

nodes.label: useDeferredValue Searchable Grid
nodes.description: Making filter updates a transition using useDeferredValue to activate ViewTransition. Per-item named VTs trigger cross-fades on every keystroke; fix with default="none".

nodes.label: Card Expand/Collapse Pattern
nodes.description: Toggle between grid and detail view using shared element morph with startTransition. Uses named ViewTransition, scroll position preservation, and state toggling.

nodes.label: N+1 ORM Query Problem
nodes.description: A list page that loops over results and fetches related records per-item. Common with Prisma .findUnique inside .map. Fix with include or DataLoader batch.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Spec-Driven Workflow
nodes.description: Spec-driven change workflow with artifacts (proposal, design, tasks) tracked in openspec/changes/. Skills loaded from .opencode/skills/openspec-*.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Change Lifecycle
nodes.description: Lifecycle of a change: propose (create artifacts) -> apply (implement tasks) -> archive (move to archive). Supports fluid workflow with interleaved actions.

nodes.label: TEI Corpus Explorer
nodes.description: Sema platform for exploring XML TEI P5 document corpora (medieval charters) with public corpus table, entity knowledge graph, and admin form for creating TEI documents.

nodes.label: Build Corpus Pipeline
nodes.description: Data flow from data/corpus/*.xml through build-corpus.ts to public/corpus-metadata.json and through build-entity-graph.ts to public/entity-graph.json. Build order matters.

nodes.label: Config-Driven Columns
nodes.description: Corpus columns defined in config/columns.yaml, admin form sections in config/form-sections.yaml. Both are YAML config loaded at runtime. Add/reorder/hide columns with no code changes.

nodes.label: Observability First
nodes.description: Core doctrine of vercel-optimize: metrics first, deterministic gates, candidate-bound scope, version-aware citations. Do not inspect source files until signals.json exists and gates point to candidates.

nodes.label: Deterministic Gates
nodes.description: Gate-investigations.mjs decides what deserves investigation using deterministic JavaScript thresholds. No LLM decides whether a metric qualifies.

nodes.label: Candidate-Bound Scope
nodes.description: Read only files named by a candidate or a route-local import chain. Sub-agents that reach for repo-wide grep indicate a malformed candidate.

nodes.label: Version-Aware Citations
nodes.description: Using only references/docs-library.json for citations. Invalid or version-mismatched citations are stripped. No invented URLs or version-mismatched framework APIs.

nodes.content: Windows setup guide for Sema project. Prerequisites: Node.js LTS. Quick start via start.bat. Manual setup: npm install, npm run build-json, npm run dev. Fake data generation with npm run generate-fake. Git sync instructions for sharing corpus changes.

Design document for adding a collapsible left sidebar with grouped facet filters to the corpus table. Key decisions: build-time facet computation, charter type from ID prefix, OR logic within facets, global search as client-side text matching, sidebar starts closed.

Proposal for faceted search sidebar. Adds collapsible left sidebar with grouped facet filters, build-time facet computation, charter type as filterable dimension, global search bar across all metadata and text fields. OR logic within facets, values sorted by count descending.

Task breakdown for faceted search sidebar implementation. 6 major tasks: Build Script (computeFacets, extractCharterTypes), Type Definitions (FacetValue, Facets, CharterType), Sidebar Component (FacetSidebar, grouped sections, checkboxes), Global Search, Table Integration (sidebar toggle, URL state sync), Verification.

Spec for build-time facet computation. Requirements: compute distinct values and counts for filterable columns at build time, extract charter type from document ID prefix, map charter type IDs to human-readable labels, handle multi-valued fields (arrays), exclude empty/whitespace-only values.

Spec for faceted search sidebar. Requirements: sidebar toggle, starts closed, facet groups (Charter Type, People, Places, Date, Archive), distinct values with counts, sort by count descending, multi-select within facet, OR logic, global search bar, global search across all fields, charter type facet from ID prefix, date range filter, URL state sync, clear all filters.

Design document for admin publish interface. Key decisions: GitHub PAT via HTTPS instead of SSH, token self-service via UI popup saved to data/.github-token, git execution via child_process.exec in API routes, embedded panel in admin dashboard, two-phase publish flow (status preview then confirm), commit only corpus files.

Proposal for admin publish interface. Adds PublishPanel component in admin dashboard showing git status, API /api/admin/publish for commit and push, API /api/admin/publish/status for git status, GitHub PAT authentication support. Enables one-click publishing for non-technical curators.

Task breakdown for admin publish interface. 8 major tasks: Git utility library (getGitStatus, publishChanges, setRemoteWithToken), Token storage utility, API routes (GET status, POST token, POST publish), PublishPanel frontend component, Integration into admin dashboard, Verification.

Spec for publish API. Requirements: GET /api/admin/publish/status returns git status (hasChanges, files, lastCommit, branch), POST /api/admin/publish executes git add/commit/pull --rebase/push, POST /api/admin/publish/token saves GitHub PAT to data/.github-token. Authentication via PAT, safety: only corpus files staged.

Spec for publish interface. Requirements: status preview showing git changes, publish button with confirmation dialog, loading states, error handling, token setup modal when no token configured, last publish info display. Panel integrated into admin dashboard below document table.

Design document for enhancing document view and form. Key decisions: charter code derivation from type ID (first letters of words), progressive numbering per-type (6-digit padded), full text in TEI as div type='full_text', content tabs architecture (4 modes), download mechanism (.txt, .xml, .pdf), investitor extraction, default visible columns (6), admin form tabs (3 tabs).

Proposal for enhancing document view and form. 7 changes: new document ID format, default visible columns reduction, refined preliminary info styling, content mode tabs in View, download dropdown, post-content placeholder sections, remove testes_text field. New capabilities: document-id-format, document-full-text, document-content-tabs, document-download, pdf-generation.

Task breakdown for enhancing document view and form. 10 major tasks: Config updates (remove testes_text, add full_text/investitor_name columns), Types and data model, Backend XML builder and ID generation, Build scripts corpus extraction, API route progressive numbering, Frontend CorpusTable default columns, Frontend DocumentCard refactor (tabs, download, post-content), PDF generation, Admin form tabs, Cleanup and verification.

Spec for corpus table default columns. Modified requirement: default visible columns reduced to datatio_chronica, datatio_topica, notarius plus computed ID and Current Location columns. ID column shows short format, always visible, non-toggleable. Current Location joins repository and shelfmark.

Spec for document content tabs. Added requirement: tab bar with 4 exclusive content modes (Testo integrale, Formulary analysis, XML TEI, Riproduzione fotografica). Full text in scrollable pre element, formulary analysis shows diplomatic clauses, XML fetched from API with loading states, photo tab shows placeholder.
Spec for document download. Added requirement: download dropdown in View offering Testo integrale (.txt), XML TEI (.xml from API), Formulary analysis (PDF from /api/pdf/formulary).

Spec for document full text. Added requirement: full text field in admin form (dedicated Full Text tab), stored in TEI XML as div type='full_text' inside text/body, extracted in corpus build for display in View.

Spec for document ID format. Added requirement: IDs in format charter-code_NNNNNN. Multi-word type IDs derive code from first letters (instrumentum_venditionis -> iv), single-word take first 2 letters (emphyteusis -> em). Progressive numbering per type, 6-digit padded. buildFilename returns only the code.

Decision: Compute distinct values and counts in build-corpus.ts and embed in corpus-metadata.json. Rationale: corpus small enough, build-time is faster, deterministic, keeps UI code simple, ensures accurate counts. Alternative rejected: client-side computation on mount causes flash of unfiltered UI.

Decision: Parse document ID prefix to extract charter type and map to human label. Rationale: charter type semantically important but not stored as separate TEI field, ID convention established and reliable. Alternative rejected: adding new TEI element would require updating all XML files and admin form.

Decision: OR logic within facets (selecting multiple values unions results). Rationale: standard behavior in faceted search (Amazon, JSTOR, Zotero), selecting multiple archives wants documents from either. Alternative rejected: AND logic contradicts user expectations.

Decision: Global search as case-insensitive substring match across all string fields. Rationale: no indexing library needed for current corpus size, simple, fast enough, no new dependencies. Alternative rejected: Fuse.js or Lunr.js integration unnecessary.

Decision: Sidebar hidden by default, opens via toggle button. Rationale: table is primary view, open sidebar reduces table width on smaller screens, users who want filtering will find toggle. Alternative rejected: open by default competes with table for space.

Decision: Use GitHub Personal Access Token via HTTPS instead of SSH. Rationale: SSH key setup complex for non-technical users, PAT generatable from GitHub UI with minimal permissions, temporary remote URL override with token. Alternative rejected: Octokit API more code and harder to debug, simple-git adds unnecessary dependency.

Decision: Token self-service via UI popup saved to data/.github-token (gitignored). Rationale: token never exposed to client, file read via fs.readFileSync at each operation, not .env.local which requires server restart. Alternative rejected: .env.local write invisible without restart.

Decision: Use child_process.exec (promisified) in Next.js API routes for git commands. Rationale: zero external dependencies, standard git commands easily debuggable, dev server has filesystem and git access, API route is server-side so tokens never reach client.
Decision: Two-phase publish flow (status preview then confirm). Rationale: give visibility on what will be published before acting, prevent accidental publishes, synchronous git operations are fast.

Decision: Auto-derive charter code from type ID via algorithm: multi-word IDs take first letter of each word, single-word IDs take first 2 letters. Rationale: algorithm covers current cases and is predictable. Alternative rejected: explicit code field in form-sections.yaml adds config maintenance.

Decision: Progressive numbering per-type (6-digit padded). When creating document, scan files matching code_*.xml, find highest number, increment. Rationale: predictable, per-type progressive avoids global counter. Migration impact: existing XML files must be renamed.

Decision: Store full text as div type='full_text' inside text/body, sibling of protocol, textus, and eschatocol. Extracted via XPath column tei:text/tei:body/tei:div[@type='full_text']. Rationale: consistent with existing TEI structure.

Decision: DocumentCard gains tab bar with 4 buttons below preliminary info. Only one tab active at a time. XML tab fetches on demand with loading/error states. Full text and formulary data from already-loaded corpus-metadata.json. Rationale: lazy-load XML to avoid performance issues, reuse existing data.

Decision: Dropdown button with three options: Testo integrale (.txt) via client-side blob, XML TEI (.xml) via existing API endpoint, Formulary analysis (PDF) via @react-pdf/renderer server-side. Rationale: declarative React component rendering benefits complex formulary structure. Alternative rejected: client-side jsPDF/html2pdf.

nodes.label: Compound Components Pattern
nodes.description: Pattern of structuring complex components as compound components with shared context, where each subcomponent accesses shared state via context not props. Consumers compose the pieces they need.

nodes.label: Avoid Boolean Prop Proliferation
nodes.description: Core principle: don't add boolean props like isThread, isEditing to customize component behavior. Each boolean doubles possible states creating unmaintainable conditionals. Use composition instead.

nodes.label: Context Dependency Injection
nodes.description: Pattern of defining generic context interfaces with state, actions, and meta sections. Any provider can implement the interface enabling same UI components with different state implementations.

nodes.label: Lift State into Providers
nodes.description: Moving state management into dedicated provider components allows sibling components outside the main UI to access and modify state without prop drilling or refs.

nodes.label: React 19 API Changes

nodes.label: React Native Performance Skills

nodes.label: List Virtualization and Optimization
nodes.description: Using virtualizers (LegendList, FlashList) for lists, avoiding inline objects in renderItem, hoisting callbacks, passing primitives for memoization, keeping items lightweight, and using item types for heterogeneous lists.

nodes.label: GPU-Accelerated Animation
nodes.description: Animating only transform and opacity for GPU acceleration, using useDerivedValue over useAnimatedReaction, and GestureDetector for animated press states with UI thread worklets.

nodes.label: State Must Represent Ground Truth
nodes.description: State variables should represent actual state of something (pressed, progress, isOpen) not derived visual values (scale, opacity). Derive visual values from state using computation or interpolation.

nodes.label: Stable Object References for Lists
nodes.description: Virtualization relies on object reference stability. Don't map/filter data before passing to virtualized lists. Use Zustand selectors within list items for dynamic data.

nodes.label: React View Transitions

nodes.label: Shared Element Transitions
